assumptions.brick: TABULA includes new 120 mm brick directly in nominal resistance. No ventilated cavity is modelled; support, ties and moisture/drainage interfaces are project details.

attic.carbon_proxy: Boverket 6000000005, attic glass blowing wool at 15 kg/m³ and lambda 0.042
attic.thickness: TABULA final nominal thermal depth; settlement allowance and deep-fill installation assessment remain required.

floor.placement: Internal floating overlay above the retained basement slab; the brochure supports warm-side placement, while the EPS/screed completion is an EPSM choice.
floor.thermal_and_carbon_screed_proxy: Existing generic concrete, not a verified screed product.
floor.accessories: Separator, reinforcement, edges, moisture protection and final finish are unquantified project details.
floor.original_floor_completion: Nominal 80 mm cement-finished concrete topping closes the baseline LECA surface and is retained beneath renovation EPS; see evidence/mf_se01_basement_floor_finish.json.

optics.shgc: glazing g × (1 − frame fraction), negligible frame gain
optics.vt: Selected glazing VT assumptions 0.65/0.60 use prior nominal VT numbers, then multiply by (1 − frame fraction); the prior fields did not independently establish glazing VT, and TABULA makes no VT claim.
optics.excluded_factors: Angular correction and external shading are handled by simulation, not multiplied into material SHGC.

scope: Only MF SE.01 standard/advanced and their generic MF fallbacks change. Original fabric and other archetypes are retained.

boundary_resolution.physical_roles: Basement slab and buried basement wall of a conditioned basement, both soil-facing.
boundary_resolution.advanced_wall_measure: 40 mm internal stone-wool addition implemented; 13 mm gypsum is an explicit EPSM completion.
boundary_resolution.remaining_not_assessed: Ground-effective U acceptance remains unavailable because source U conventions are incompatible and project ground calculation inputs are absent.
